verdict.rationale: Dover's own docs say you can send candidates a booking link so they pick a time, and that with Full permissions Dover books the interview directly on your calendar, so candidate self-scheduling is a native capability. The evidence does not show that the booking link reflects live availability across a team's calendars, nor that it handles timezones. missing for 10: evidence that booking links read live availability across multiple team members' calendars, timezone handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains

citations.quote: Send the candidate a booking link so they pick a time
With **Full permissions**, Dover books the interview directly on your calendar.
